oracle-l5r-10358.note: A Cleansing Breath (Strategy, issue #736): "Battle/Open: Target your Personality at any location. He centers himself. Negate other players' cards' effects that prevent him assigning, moving or performing actions. If he is a Kensai, straighten his unit." The negations are P12 Prevention and movement/assignment immunities, but "he centers himself" has no definition anywhere in the repository (core rules, rulings or code): it names a rule the owner has not given. Needs Mendon's ruling on what centering does before the card is built; publishing it without the sentence would drop printed text.

oracle-l5r-10473.note: Asako Kaitoko - exp (Personality, issue #736): "Personalities with Fallen, Kolat, Ninja, Nonhuman, or Shadowlands opposing Kaitoko have a maximum Force of 3, and actions from cards in their units may not target Kaitoko." Two gaps: a maximum Force is a stat cap and none exists (P9 left StatCap out; PersonalityForce is additive, so a cap cannot be written without reading the Force it caps), and the target bar applies only to actors whose Personality has one of five keywords, which an ActorSpec cannot say.

oracle-l5r-10497.note: P'an Ku - exp (Personality, issue #736): "Open, bow: Give a target card a Madness token" is built (the existing panku-madness shape), but "Limited, bow: P'an Ku may remain bowed. Take control of a target Personality with more Madness tokens than printed Personal Honor and remove those tokens. The target will not commit seppuku until P'an Ku straightens or leaves play. After P'an Ku does, give control of the target to his owner." needs three things together: a control change that returns when a named card straightens or leaves play (TakeControl exists; the timed return trigger does not), a seppuku bar tied to that card, and "may remain bowed" (a rule exempting him from straightening). One card, three new rules.

oracle-l5r-10524.note: Koan's Jingasa (Item, issue #736): "This Personality has Shugenja, may not have more Spells than Koan cards attached, and he need not bow for his Spells with an odd Focus Value (0 is even)." The Shugenja keyword is AttachGrantsKeyword, but P11's SpellLimit counts Spell actions performed, not Spells attached (the rule here is an attachment limit counted against Koan cards), and "need not bow for his Spells" is a waiver of the bow cost of a Spell's own ability, which P24's cost waivers do not cover.
